mentions.name: Backchannel
mentions.description: A userscript that adds Hacker News, Bluesky, Reddit, and other platforms' discussions into a single blended discussion thread on any site you visit. It includes a blended homepage and is being developed as a working example of Webmentions and Web Annotations.
mentions.source_excerpt: (1) Backchannel (https://github.com/twalichiewicz/Backchannel) -- A userscript that adds Hacker News, Bluesky, Reddit, & other's discussions into a single blended discussion thread to any site you visit.
mentions.author: twalichiewicz
